an8.53:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ,
an8.53:1.2: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.53:2.1: sādhu bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpinī pahitattā vihareyyanti.
an8.53:2.2: ye kho tvaṃ gotamī, dhamme jāneyyāsi
an8.53:2.3: ime dhammā sarāgāya saṃvattanti no virāgāya,
an8.53:2.12: neso dhammo neso vinayo netaṃ satthusāsananti.
an8.53:3.1: ye ca kho tvaṃ gotamī, dhamme jāneyyāsi
an8.53:3.2: ime dhammā virāgāya saṃvattanti no sarāgāya,
an8.53:3.11: eso dhammo eso vinayo etaṃ satthusāsananti.
